sources.intro: Libraries — only for references: their works, quotes and persons can be pointed to in fields and quoted, but they don't become cards. Scriptoria — their texts (with the fields of their text kind, e.g. mystery, area) can be shown in views and matrices, pointed to in fields and learnt through templates. Other knowledge bases — to reuse: their kinds, entries, templates, reviews and flows work here, and are changed over there. Each source is seen only by those with access to its area.
sources.title: Sources
sources.addPlaceholder: — add a library, scriptorium or knowledge base —

authorsOnly: The knowledge base settings are changed by its authors.

storage.title: Where learners' answers are saved
storage.hint: Learners' progress is seen by whoever leads the chosen area (e.g. a teacher). This is the choice for learning here, in the app, and for modules without their own — a module on a course (or group) page sends answers to its own area, so the same base can serve many courses. Without a choice — only the learner themselves.

reports.title: Reports and numbers from learners (anonymous)
reports.hint: Reported cards and error counts go to the intake of this knowledge base's area — without names.

motivation.title: Motivation
motivation.rewardsDefault: — default: the base's first rules, otherwise the built-in ones —
motivation.rankings: Rankings exist only in live sessions.

language.title: Learning language
language.hint: The learning screens speak this language: the landscape, the path, the review and its ending. Without a choice — detected from the names in the base (now: {lang}).

tags.title: Perspectives
tags.hint: This base still has old perspectives ({tags}). Perspectives and topics no longer exist — order comes from your own kinds (e.g. “Mystery”, “Area”) linked by reference fields.

join.title: Page for joining a session
join.hint: A page with the “Join a session” module (e.g. parafia/quiz). The session's link and QR code lead there.

proposals.title: Proposals from readers
proposals.hint: Authors change the base directly; others propose explanations and questions, and the author accepts them.

base.title: Knowledge base
base.name: Name of the knowledge base
base.area: Area: {area} — whoever has its key learns from this base; whoever writes in it builds it.
base.deleteHint: Deletes all entries, templates, reviews, flows and learners' answers; sessions stay, but without the base. This cannot be undone — export it first (JSON).

intake.none: this area has no intake yet — only the learner will see the answers

deps.title: Dependencies
deps.hint: The learning order comes mainly from the “Must know first” fields in kinds and questions (Learning → Path); here — extra dependencies between single entries. “Must know first” blocks cards until the basis is mastered; each edge passes part of the knowledge (weight) upwards.

values.title: Course values
values.hint: They change while learning (flow steps, progress): points, closeness to characters, resources. They stay between sessions.

rules.title: Live session rules
rules.foreign: These rules are from “{name}” — they work here and are changed there.

looks.title: Looks
looks.hint: A look says how a flow shows its steps and what is visible of each kind of entry (e.g. a person's card: name, years, portrait).

daily.label: Daily goal — cards per day
daily.hint: A streak is the days in a row on which the goal is reached. Each learner sees only their own days.
